rules: All labels are verbatim from their source; do not reword them.

source = outline: verbatim outline item. split: verbatim words, an agent chose the item boundaries. filled: agent-written to fill a gap (based_on names its source). split and filled stops are shown but never used in measurements.
Stops are in outline order; the order is the route. A route may visit the same node more than once.

route_links: from -> to reads "the course -> a course it requires". Empty alternative_group: required. Rows sharing an alternative_group are alternatives (choose one); a ".B1"/".B2" suffix marks a branch whose rows are taken together; values sharing everything before ".B" are the alternatives of one choice (data/derived/calendar/README.md).

edges: CS2023 "See also" notes, collapsed to knowledge unit -> knowledge unit (from = the unit the note is printed in, to = the unit it names; type = see_also). notes = how many notes the pair carries (a note naming several units counts on each of their edges, so the edges' notes add up to more than the number of notes); note_ids point to rows of cs2023_see_also.csv. A note sits under one topic (or a tier heading) but names a whole unit, so drawing it unit to unit loses the topic it was attached to; attached_to keeps it. Links to the note's own unit are dropped (there are none). One printed target (MSF-Protection) matches no unit and is not drawn. No other edges exist; none may be invented.
